design.jobs: C3: C at plus3, 10 targets x seeds 12770101, 12770102 = 20; C1: C at plus1, 10 x 12770101; T3: T at plus3, 10 x 2; 50 jobs. Smoke seed 12770301 (SJ, KR; C1,T3) not gated

design.time: JOB_KILL 900 s; wall_guard_case_s=900; MAIN_CAP 4800 s per orchestrator invocation; main launched once, one resume restart allowed if parent dies with missing keys

diagnostic_not_gated: resume count; per-target kill reasons; wall_guard events

gates.GHEAD77: HEADLINE: C3 IDF recounted correct on >=6 of 20 cells covering >=3 targets, 0 WRONG
gates.GHELD77: >=1 of 4 held-out C3 cells decided, 0 WRONG
gates.GHOST77: git diff v0.72.0..run_start -- brute is empty

honest_framing: v0.72.0 applied wall_guard_case_s=900 but the parent died after 1/50 (deviation #216); the one recovered record showed the measurement fix works. This version keeps the measurement fix and adds a PROCESS fix: persist jobs under results/study-077/main/jobs/, skip keys that already have JSON, allow one orchestrator restart to finish missing keys only (never re-run finished), then seal. Not an algorithmic bump.
